introText: Leave the table empty and the adapter finds MusicCast devices on the network by itself at startup — nothing to enter. Add devices (name + IP) to use only those instead. Older receivers (before ~2010, XML protocol) do not announce themselves on the network and must always be added here manually.
tooltip_xmlPollInterval: This field appears because a device is connected over the old XML protocol (a receiver from before ~2010). Such devices do not report changes on their own, they are polled. Default: every 60 seconds — plenty for an AV receiver.

networkInterfaceTooltip: Select the network interface for LAN discovery and control. Keep the default (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces) unless this host has multiple network interfaces.
